org.mission.motto: Participation is free. Support is voluntary. Trust has to be earned.
org.mission.s1.body:
Entrepreneurship should bring not only profit but also freedom. And buying goods and receiving services should help people meet their needs without taking away extra time and effort.

We bring together entrepreneurs and customers who share these beliefs and want to shape a new business culture together, one based on trust, quality, fair relationships and mutual benefit.
org.mission.s1.title: We believe business should improve life, not complicate it.
org.mission.s2.body:
Not through intrusive advertising, manipulation and endless discounts, but through understanding needs, quality service, an honest price and keeping promises.

With every purchase a customer votes for the kind of business they want to see around them. And every entrepreneur, by the way they treat customers, decides whether they deserve their trust.
org.mission.s2.title: We believe good business is built on customer loyalty, and loyalty has to be earned.
org.mission.s3.body:
Routine work should be done by machines. Artificial intelligence should help make decisions and solve problems. Data should bring understanding, not exist for the sake of reporting.

A business should be a clear, manageable and sustainable system, not a constant source of stress and dependence on the owner's daily involvement.

We support an AI First approach: when creating and improving processes, first look for sensible uses of artificial intelligence and automation.

But for us technology is not an end in itself. Its value is measured by how much time, effort and resources it saves people.
org.mission.s3.title: We believe technology should set people free.
org.mission.s4.body:
That is why we are creating an open space where anyone can ask a question, describe a problem, suggest an idea, or share a success or a mistake.

We help explore problems, find solutions, develop ideas and turn individual experience into knowledge that is useful to the whole community.

We respect authorship, welcome different opinions, and are convinced that constructive criticism and open dialogue help us get better.
org.mission.s4.title: We believe knowledge and experience become more valuable when they are shared.
org.mission.s5.body:
There is no need to wait for someone else to create ideal conditions for business or good service.

Entrepreneurs can improve their companies today. Customers can support worthy businesses with their choices. And together we can set new standards of relationships and quality.

Our goal is to bring together people who do not just talk about better business but create it through their actions.

We do not aim to make everyone the same. We want good ideas to spread, useful solutions to become available, and respect for a person and their time to become the norm.
org.mission.s5.title: We believe change starts with ourselves.
org.mission.s6.body: A community where entrepreneurship brings freedom, technology serves people, trust is earned by actions, and every member can contribute.
org.mission.s6.title: We are building a community in which business and customers help each other become better.
org.mission.subtitle: A community of conscious business
